readme.html:
Motion Design Skills

Motion design fundamentals, engines, and brand elements as installable skills for AI coding agents — timing, typography, color, composition, After Effects, Remotion, logos, and backgrounds.

Install

npx skills add iart-ai/motion-design-skills

Or add it as a Claude Code plugin marketplace:

/plugin marketplace add iart-ai/motion-design-skills

then /plugin install motion-design-skills.

The skills run in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 40+ agents. The full agent runs at iart.ai.

What's included

Skill What it does
animation-principles Tech-agnostic timing, easing, and the 12 principles for natural-feeling motion.
color-motion Palettes, gradients, perceptual interpolation (OKLCH/Lab), grading, and render color management.
shot-composition Grids, safe areas, focal hierarchy, and 2D/3D camera framing across aspect ratios.
motion-art-direction Senior creative direction — motion language, tone, pacing, hierarchy, and restraint.
after-effects AE expressions, rigging, export recipes, performance triage, and project hygiene.
beat-sync-editing Cut to the beat — editing rhythm, transitions, retiming, and speed ramps.
remotion-video Programmatic, data-driven video in React rendered to MP4/GIF via CLI or renderer.
logo-animation Logo reveals, stingers, splash screens, and loaders for web, video, and app.
motion-background Mesh gradients, shader auroras, particle constellations, and subtle looping backgrounds.

When it activates

  • You ask to fix, time, or polish how something moves (stiff, floaty, robotic, snappy).
  • You're animating text, logos, or backgrounds for the web, video, or an app.
  • You're building or rendering video programmatically with Remotion or working in After Effects.
  • You're directing the overall look — pacing, color, composition, and consistency.
  • You're editing a sequence to music or planning shot rhythm.

Example prompts

  • "Make this animation feel natural — it looks robotic and stiff."
  • "Build a kinetic typography video with a staggered split-text reveal."
  • "Animate our logo into a 3-second brand intro with a sound-logo sync."
  • "Create a data-driven video in Remotion that renders one MP4 per CSV row."
  • "Add a subtle looping mesh-gradient background behind the hero."
